areas.t: Mostly good air quality will continue with an active but mostly dry pattern through the next week.  Fog and haze may lead to occasional episodes of moderate fine particulate matter.  Prescribed or agricultural fires may produce locally unhealthy smoke.  Rain showers will move through parts of Oklaho
